scoring_policy: Provisional evidence-weighted research score, not an activation decision. Missing quantitative facts receive - (1) as an uncertainty penalty, not a measured adverse result. +/- (2) and + (3) express explicit source-supported judgments; operator claims are labeled. Unknown initial-screen facts remain Unknown. Template category weights and rating mapping unchanged. Target TAM and G&B fit are informational, not extra weighted score inputs.
